items.dir: Directions: You have just finished a course taught by a foreign teacher. Write a letter to him or her to express your gratitude. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明写信目的，感谢一学期的教导
具体说明哪一点帮助最大（如口语纠音、写作批改）
表达祝愿，希望保持联系
fr: 第一段：点明身份与写信目的——课程结束，写信致谢
第二段：举一个具体事例说明收获，避免空泛赞美
第三段：再次感谢，表达祝愿与保持联系的愿望
items.es:
Dear Mr. Smith,

I am Li Ming, a student from Class Three. Now that the oral English course has come to an end, I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your teaching over the past term.

What impressed me most was the way you corrected my pronunciation. In the first weeks, I was afraid to speak in class because my accent made me nervous. You listened patiently, wrote the problem sounds on the board and asked me to practise them in short dialogues. Thanks to your encouragement, I can now give a presentation without reading every word.

Your class has made English a habit rather than a subject for me. I will keep reading and speaking every day. I wish you all the best in your future work, and I hope we can stay in touch by email.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
ph: express my sincere gratitude for ... 对……表示诚挚感谢
What impressed me most was ... 给我印象最深的是……
Thanks to your encouragement ... 多亏你的鼓励
stay in touch with sb. 与某人保持联系

items.dir: Directions: Your university is going to hold a Chinese Culture Festival. Write a letter to invite Professor Brown, a visiting scholar, to attend it. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明活动名称、时间和地点
介绍活动内容与邀请理由
说明回复方式，表达期待
fr: 第一段：自我介绍，说明邀请事由
第二段：介绍时间、地点与主要环节，说明为何想到对方
第三段：请对方确认行程，表达期待
items.es:
Dear Professor Brown,

I am Wang Fang, chair of the Student Union of the Foreign Languages School. On behalf of our school, I am writing to invite you to the Chinese Culture Festival, which will be held in the Student Centre from 2 p.m. to 6 p.m. on 20 May.

The festival will include calligraphy workshops, a tea ceremony and a short stage performance. Since you have studied Chinese poetry for many years, we would be honoured if you could give a ten-minute talk on how poetry reflects everyday life. Your talk would give students a fresh view of the culture they are learning about.

Please let me know whether you are available by 10 May so that we can arrange the seating and the schedule. We sincerely hope you can join us.

Yours sincerely,
Wang Fang
ph: On behalf of ..., I am writing to invite you to ... 我代表……写信邀请您……
We would be honoured if you could ... 如您能……我们将深感荣幸
whether you are available 您是否有空
give students a fresh view of ... 让学生对……有新认识

items.dir: Directions: A international sports event is recruiting volunteers. Write a letter to apply for the position. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明申请岗位与信息来源
介绍自身优势（语言、经验、时间）
表达服务意愿，请求面试机会
fr: 第一段：说明从何处得知招募信息，申请何岗位
第二段：用具体经历说明自己为何合适
第三段：说明可投入时间，请求进一步联系
items.es:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am a second-year student majoring in English at Nanjing University. I learned from the volunteer recruitment notice that you are looking for assistants for the international sports event, and I would like to apply for the reception desk position.

Two points may make me a suitable candidate. First, I have passed CET-6 and worked as an interpreter for a foreign delegation during last year's campus fair, so I am used to communicating with visitors under pressure. Second, I am patient and organized; as a class monitor, I have arranged schedules for more than forty students.

I will be free from 10 July to 20 August and can work six days a week. I would be grateful for the chance to attend an interview at your convenience.

Yours faithfully,
Li Hua
ph: I learned from ... that ... 我从……得知……
Two points may make me a suitable candidate. 两点或许能说明我适合这一岗位。
I am used to doing sth. 我习惯于做某事
at your convenience 在您方便的时候

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to the library to complain about the noise problem during the exam period. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明投诉的具体问题与发生时间
说明对学习造成的影响
提出可行的改进建议
fr: 第一段：说明身份，指出问题所在区域与时段
第二段：描述具体情形及影响，语气克制
第三段：提出两三条可操作建议，期待回复
items.es:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am a junior student who studies in the library almost every day. I am writing to report a problem that has become serious during the exam period.

In the reading room on the third floor, students often discuss their group projects at normal speaking volume, and some watch videos without earphones. Last Tuesday I sat there for three hours but finished only half of my reading. Several classmates have moved to the canteen, which is far from ideal for quiet study.

I would suggest setting aside one room for group discussion and putting up reminder signs at the entrance of the silent area. It would also help if staff walked through the reading room once every hour.

I hope these suggestions will be considered, and I look forward to your reply.

Yours faithfully,
Zhang Wei
ph: I am writing to report a problem ... 我写信反映一个问题
at normal speaking volume 以正常说话音量
set aside ... for ... 把……留作……之用
I look forward to your reply. 期待您的回复。

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to the university president to suggest improvements to the campus canteen. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 肯定现有优点，指出待改进之处
说明问题带来的具体不便
提出具体建议
fr: 第一段：说明写信目的，先肯定食堂的努力
第二段：指出两个具体问题（如排队时间、菜品单一）
第三段：给出可执行建议，表达信任
items.es:
Dear President,

I am a sophomore writing to share some thoughts on the campus canteen. I would like to begin by thanking the staff, whose work has clearly improved since the new menu was introduced last term.

Two problems, however, still affect daily life. First, the queue at the second-floor window is often twenty minutes long between 12:00 and 12:30, which leaves little time for a short rest before afternoon classes. Second, vegetarian dishes are limited to one or two options, so students with special dietary needs often eat the same meal for a week.

May I suggest opening an extra window during peak hours and adding two vegetarian dishes each day? A simple online menu would also help students decide before they queue.

Thank you for your time, and I trust the canteen will continue to improve.

Yours sincerely,
Chen Jing
ph: I would like to begin by thanking ... 首先我要感谢……
be limited to 仅限于
May I suggest ...? 我可以建议……吗？
during peak hours 在高峰时段

items.dir: Directions: You borrowed a book from your professor and accidentally damaged it. Write a letter to apologize. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明事情经过，直接致歉
说明补救措施
再次致歉，承诺改进
fr: 第一段：开门见山说明来意并道歉
第二段：交代损坏经过，不找借口
第三段：提出赔偿或替换方案
items.es:
Dear Professor Liu,

I am writing to apologize for damaging the book you kindly lent me last month, A Short History of Modern Europe.

On Friday I carried it in my backpack during a rainstorm. The bottom of the bag was wet, and about twenty pages at the back are now wrinkled. I only noticed the damage when I opened it in the library. I should have put it in a plastic folder, and I am sorry that I did not take better care of something you trusted me with.

I have ordered a new copy, which should arrive early next week. I will bring it to your office as soon as it comes, and I am also happy to pay for any difference in price. I promise to be more careful with borrowed materials in the future.

Yours sincerely,
Zhao Lei
ph: I am writing to apologize for ... 我写信为……道歉
I should have done ... 我本应该……
take care of 保管、照料
be happy to do 乐意做

items.dir: Directions: Write a notice for the student union about a lecture on time management. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明讲座主题、主讲人与时间地点
介绍讲座内容与适合人群
说明报名方式与注意事项
fr: 第一段：通知事项，要素齐全（主题、主讲、时间、地点）
第二段：简介内容与收获
第三段：报名方式与截止时间
items.es:
Notice

A lecture on time management will be held in Lecture Hall 2 from 7 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. on Wednesday, 15 November. The speaker is Dr. Wang Lei, a psychologist who has worked with university students for over ten years.

The lecture will focus on three questions: how to plan a week realistically, how to deal with interruptions, and how to keep energy levels steady during exam periods. Dr. Wang will also analyse two common habits that waste time and suggest practical alternatives. Students who often stay up late to finish assignments will find the talk especially useful.

Admission is free, but seats are limited to 150. Please scan the QR code on the poster to sign up before Monday, 13 November. Latecomers will be asked to stand at the back.

Student Union
ph: will be held in ... from ... to ... 将于……在……举行
Admission is free. 免费入场。
seats are limited to 150 座位仅限 150 个
Latecomers will be asked to ... 迟到者将被要求……

items.dir: Directions: Write a notice for a reading club recruiting new members. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 介绍社团定位与活动频率
说明招新对象与要求
报名方式与截止时间
fr: 第一段：社团简介与活动安排
第二段：招新对象、人数与要求
第三段：报名方式、面试安排
items.es:
Notice

The Reading Club is looking for new members for the coming term. We meet every Thursday evening in Room 305 of the library, and each session lasts about ninety minutes. Members take turns to introduce a book, and the rest of the time is used for discussion.

We welcome students from all departments. What matters is not how many books you have read but whether you are willing to explain your ideas and listen to others. This term we plan to read six titles, including two novels and one work of popular science. Members will vote on the final list in the first meeting.

To join, please send your name, department and a short paragraph about a book you like to readingclub@campus.edu before 20 September. We will hold a brief interview for those who sign up.

Reading Club
ph: take turns to do 轮流做
What matters is not ... but whether ... 重要的不是……而是是否……
vote on 对……进行投票
sign up 报名

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to apply for a summer internship in a marketing company. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明申请岗位与信息来源
结合课程与经历说明匹配度
说明实习时间，请求面试
fr: 第一段：申请岗位与信息来源
第二段：两项与岗位相关的能力，配具体证据
第三段：时间安排与联系方式
items.es:
Dear Ms. Green,

I am writing to apply for the summer internship in your marketing department, as advertised on your company website. I am a third-year student of business administration at Sun Yat-sen University.

My coursework has given me a foundation in consumer behaviour and data analysis. Last semester my team designed a promotion plan for a local coffee shop and used a survey of 300 customers to decide which channel to invest in; the shop reported a 20 percent rise in weekend sales. I am also comfortable with Excel and have basic skills in Python for cleaning survey data.

I am available from 1 July to 31 August for five days a week. I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to discuss how I could contribute to your team.

Yours sincerely,
Liu Yang
ph: as advertised on ... 正如……上刊登的
My coursework has given me a foundation in ... 课程为我打下了……基础
be comfortable with 熟练使用
would welcome the chance to ... 希望能有机会……

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to recommend your classmate for a scholarship. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明推荐人与被推荐人关系
从学业与品格两方面说明理由
表达推荐结论
fr: 第一段：说明写信目的与认识时长
第二段：学业表现 + 一个具体事例
第三段：品格与团队贡献，明确推荐
items.es:
Dear Committee Members,

I am writing to recommend my classmate Lin Yue for the National Scholarship. I have studied with her for two years and served with her on the class committee.

Lin Yue ranks third in a class of forty-five and has won the first prize in our university's mathematics competition. What distinguishes her, however, is her willingness to explain difficult problems to others. Before last term's final exams, she organised four review sessions and prepared summary sheets for the whole class. As a result, no one in our study group failed the course.

She is also reliable. When our group project lost a member halfway through, she took over the missing part without complaint and finished it on time.

I believe she deserves the scholarship and recommend her without reservation.

Yours sincerely,
He Xin
ph: What distinguishes her is ... 让她与众不同的是……
without complaint 毫无怨言
deserve 值得、应得
recommend her without reservation 毫无保留地推荐她

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to a language school to ask about a summer course. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明自身情况与学习需求
询问课程安排、费用与住宿
说明希望收到回复的时间
fr: 第一段：自我介绍与学习目标
第二段：列出两三个具体问题
第三段：说明时间要求与联系方式
items.es:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am a university student in China and plan to spend four weeks in your city this summer to improve my English. I am writing to ask for more information about your intensive courses.

First, could you tell me the difference between the general course and the examination course? I need to take an academic writing test in September, so I would like to know which one offers more practice in essay structure. Second, I would like to know the class size and whether teachers give individual feedback on written work. Finally, please let me know the total cost, including registration and teaching materials, and whether the school can help arrange accommodation with a host family.

I hope to receive your reply before 15 April so that I can apply for a visa in time.

Yours faithfully,
Sun Qian
ph: I am writing to ask for more information about ... 我写信想了解……的更多信息
the difference between A and B
individual feedback on ... 对……的个别反馈
in time 及时

items.dir: Directions: Your friend has won a national speech contest. Write a letter to congratulate him or her. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 直接表达祝贺
回顾对方的努力过程，说明实至名归
送上祝愿，提出小聚
fr: 第一段：得知消息，表达祝贺
第二段：回忆准备过程，突出努力与坚持
第三段：祝愿与约定
items.es:
Dear Ming,

I saw the news on the university website this morning: first prize in the national English speech contest. Congratulations! I read the report twice to make sure I had not mistaken the name.

I still remember the evenings in March when you practised in the empty classroom. You recorded yourself, listened to the playback and rewrote the same opening five times. There were days when you almost gave up because your pronunciation would not cooperate, but you came back the next morning. The prize is not luck; it is the result of those months.

I hope this gives you the confidence to try even bigger stages. When you are back on campus, let's have dinner and celebrate properly.

Yours,
Tao
ph: I read the report twice to make sure ... 我把报道读了两遍以确认……
the playback 录音回放
The prize is not luck; it is the result of ... 这个奖不是运气，而是……的结果
celebrate properly 好好庆祝

ol: 说明申请项目与自身专业

items.es:
Dear Selection Committee,

I am writing to apply for the one-semester exchange programme with the University of Leeds. I am a third-year student of environmental engineering.

I have passed IELTS with an overall score of 7.0 and have studied two courses taught in English. In 2024 I joined a summer camp in Yunnan where I worked with volunteers from five countries to monitor water quality in a mountain village. That experience taught me how to explain technical findings to people without a scientific background, a skill I believe will be useful in Leeds.

If selected, I plan to take courses in water resource management and environmental economics. On returning, I hope to write my graduation thesis on urban drainage and to share what I have learned with younger students.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely,
Wu Han
ph: If selected, I plan to ... 如果入选，我计划……
an overall score of 7.0 总分 7.0
share what I have learned with ... 与……分享所学
Thank you for considering my application. 感谢考虑我的申请。

items.dir: Directions: Write a letter to freshmen offering advice on preparing for CET-6. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
ol: 说明写信目的与自身经验
给出两三条可操作建议
鼓励坚持，说明心态重要性
fr: 第一段：自我介绍，说明刚通过考试
第二段：三条建议，按优先级排列
第三段：心态与鼓励
items.es:
Dear Freshmen,

I am a senior who passed CET-6 last December. Since many of you have asked how to prepare, I would like to share three suggestions.

First, treat vocabulary as a daily habit rather than a task before the exam. Twenty words a day for three months is far more effective than two hundred words in one week. Second, do real papers under timed conditions. Reading three passages in forty minutes feels very different from reading them without a clock. Third, keep a notebook of mistakes: after each paper, write down why you chose the wrong option, not just the correct answer.

Finally, do not panic if your first mock score is low. Progress in listening and reading is slow at the beginning and then suddenly visible. Give the method eight weeks before you judge it.

Good luck,
Xu Ming
ph: treat A as B 把 A 当作 B
under timed conditions 在限时条件下
far more effective than 远比……有效
before you judge it 在你评判它之前

ol: 说明活动目的、时间与地点
说明捐赠要求与图书去向
说明激励方式与联系方式
fr: 第一段：活动目的与安排要素
第二段：对图书的要求与不接受的范围
第三段：图书去向、纪念方式与咨询方式
items.es:
Notice

The library will hold a book donation activity from 1 to 10 December to help build small reading rooms in three rural primary schools.

We welcome textbooks, children's literature, popular science and dictionaries published after 2015. Books should be complete and free of heavy notes. Please do not bring magazines, examination papers or damaged copies, as they are difficult to use in a school library.

All donated books will be sorted by volunteers and delivered before the winter holiday. Donors will receive a card showing where their books are sent, and those who give more than ten books will have their names listed on the library website.

Donations can be left at the service desk on the first floor between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. For further information, please call 6789-1234.

Library
ph: free of heavy notes 无大量笔记
be sorted by volunteers 由志愿者分类
For further information, please call ... 详情请致电……
published after 2015 2015 年后出版
